tldr: Sun through the 8th house brings focus to shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement.
body: Sun transiting the 8th house illuminates shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement. For about a month, attention, vitality, and conscious focus move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a visibility transit: it shows where your life force wants to be recognized, strengthened, and chosen consciously.
business: Sun supports shared money and deep trust: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Ego inflation, overexposure, or control, avoidance, or crisis attachment.
advice: Use the spotlight in the 8th house deliberately. Work with shared resources, debt, intimacy, grief, and entanglement without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
